# 10-year constant maturity yields from the data

# 1993 data (from treasury_bulletin_1994_03_page_78.txt)

    'Jun': 5.96, 'Jul': 5.81, 'Aug': 5.68, 'Sep': 5.36, 'Oct': 5.33, 
    'Nov': 5.72, 'Dec': 5.77
}

# 1998 data (from treasury_bulletin_1999_03_page_55.txt)
yields_1998 = {
    'Jan': 5.54, 'Feb': 5.57, 'Mar': 5.65, 'Apr': 5.64, 'May': 5.65, 
    'Jun': 5.50, 'Jul': 5.46, 'Aug': 5.34, 'Sep': 4.81, 'Oct': 4.53, 
    'Nov': 4.83, 'Dec': 4.65
}

# 2003 data (from treasury_bulletin_2004_03_page_53.txt)
yields_2003 = {
    'Jan': 4.05, 'Feb': 3.90, 'Mar': 3.81, 'Apr': 3.96, 'May': 3.57, 
    'Jun': 3.33, 'Jul': 3.98, 'Aug': 4.45, 'Sep': 4.27, 'Oct': 4.29, 
    'Nov': 4.30, 'Dec': 4.27
}

# Month order
months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

# Calculate 3-month moving averages for March through December
# For each target month M, we average the current month and the two previous months

def compute_moving_averages(yields):
    results = {}
    for target_idx in range(2, 12):  # March (index 2) through December (index 11)
        target_month = months[target_idx]
        # Get the 3 months: current month and two prior
        m1 = yields[months[target_idx]]
        m2 = yields[months[target_idx - 1]]
        m3 = yields[months[target_idx - 2]]
        avg = (m1 + m2 + m3) / 3
        results[target_month] = round(avg, 2)
    return results

print("1993 Moving Averages (March-December):")
ma_1993 = compute_moving_averages(yields_1993)
for k, v in ma_1993.items():
    print(f"  {k}: {v}")

print("\n1998 Moving Averages (March-December):")
ma_1998 = compute_moving_averages(yields_1998)
for k, v in ma_1998.items():

# Now compute the range across all moving averages (treating them as one subset)
all_values = list(ma_1993.values()) + list(ma_1998.values()) + list(ma_2003.values())
print("\nAll 3-month moving average values:")

min_val = min(all_values)
max_val = max(all_values)
range_val = round(max_val - min_val, 2)

print(f"\nMinimum: {min_val}")
print(f"Maximum: {max_val}")
print(f"Range: {range_val}")
EOF
